why_defective: OpenXML treats 'right' as logical trailing edge under BiDi, inverting text to the physical left in LibreOffice and Word.
observed_symptoms: Headings and captions aligned to far left of page in LibreOffice Writer
Top ruler starts at 0 on left
corrective_remedy: Omit <w:jc> on BiDi paragraphs for right alignment; inject <w:bidi/> into sectPr.

detection_heuristic.trigger_rule: Presence of <w:jc w:val="right"/> within a paragraph that also contains <w:bidi w:val="1"/>.
